question.html:
A mass is suspended by a rope and pulled sideways by a horizontal force until the rope makes an angle of to the vertical. Which of the following free-body diagrams best represents the forces acting on the mass?

  1. Tension diagonally up, weight down, horizontal force to right
  2. Weight up, tension down, horizontal force to right
  3. Weight down, tension to left, horizontal force to right
  4. Tension vertically up, weight down, no horizontal force
